entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Mondino is a French fashion photographer and music video director. He has directed music videos for Madonna, David Bowie, Sting, Björk, Don Henley, Neneh Cherry, Jaye Muller, Axel Bauer and Les Rita Mitsouko. Mondino has also photographed the covers and album packaging for Aṣa's Beautiful Imperfection (2010), the Marianne Faithfull albums Before The Poison (2005) and Easy Come, Easy Go (2008), Shakespear's Sister's Hormonally Yours (1992), Alain Bashung's Osez Joséphine (1991), Chatterton (1994), Mylène Farmer's Désobéissance (2018), J.'s We Are the Majority (1992) and Prince's Lovesexy (1988).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Mondino's work as a fashion photographer and music video director has had significant regional impact in Western Europe, particularly in the 1980s and 1990s music industry. His collaborations with notable artists have contributed to the visual identity of several iconic albums.
